scripts.docs: npm run build && redocly build-docs tsp-output/schema/3.1.0/openapi.yaml -o tsp-output/docs.html
scripts.postman:generate: npm run build && mkdir -p postman && openapi2postmanv2 -s tsp-output/schema/3.1.0/openapi.yaml -o postman/wms-service.postman_collection.json -p
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n tsp,swagger -c blue,green "tsp compile . --watch" "swagger-ui-watcher tsp-output/schema/3.0.0/openapi.yaml -p 8090 --no-open"
